headline: Lawro's Predictions: GW9
deck: Lawro goes against the favourites in three ties, siding with domeitalycoach, GlengarryHearts and Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza.
body: Five from five last week. Both gut calls came in. I don't trust it. I used to be on the Match of the Day sofa. Now I'm in the small print of a league with a side called Cowthenbeef.

ties.line:
Mac Allister has gone quiet for its_ohi these last two games. A man from that Liverpool side never stays that way for long. B.Fernandes of Manchester United is fit again after missing last week. Three wins from three and top of the table, so the fall is coming, and I'll be the one who misses it.

AtleticoTimHortons have lost two running and look soft with it. Tavernier has scored in both of his last two games, and AFC Bournemouth have Leeds United at home. AtleticoTimHortons have Lacroix of Chelsea down as a slight doubt.

B.Fernandes back in the squad is enough, and its_ohi keep the run going one more week.

The Milan Derby is ninth against tenth. Proper derbies used to be about the top of the table. Kayode is at home to Nottingham Forest for domeitalycoach, and Hall is at home to Everton. Neither visitor will frighten a back line.

The Truffle Pigs are bottom without a point, and somehow the favourites. I'm against them. The Truffle Pigs have Van de Ven facing Crystal Palace and Jacquet facing an Arsenal side that scores goals.

I don't trust either lot, but Kayode and Hall face the gentler visitors and domeitalycoach sneak it.

If anyone can, Bannan can are second. No side with a comma in its name belongs that high. Evanilson has found the net twice running for them at AFC Bournemouth. They're favoured here, and I'm going against them.

GlengarryHearts play the game properly. Isak and Virgil of Liverpool have Arsenal at home, and Arsenal won't bother Isak. I played centre-half, and Virgil defends the way I was taught. Hill, also for GlengarryHearts, has two clean sheets on the bounce for the Cherries.

Isak and Virgil play the better football, and that's enough for GlengarryHearts.

Petrović has kept the door shut two weeks in a row for The Raccoons and AFC Bournemouth. The champions have lost two of three, and nobody told them a title needs defending. Petrović is the only one who got the message.

Bayern Bru took a hiding last week and went straight to the waiver list. They came back with Andrew Robertson and Mathys Tel, two Tottenham Hotspur men nobody else wanted. Bayern Bru also have Mbeumo, away at Chelsea with Manchester United.

Manchester United at Chelsea is a difficult game for Mbeumo, and The Raccoons come through it.

The Subway Sandwich Siesta is aptly named, and I'll be asleep by half-time. Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza have Gakpo with Liverpool at home to Arsenal. Arsenal are hard to score against, which won't trouble Gakpo. They also hold Gabriel, who hasn't conceded in two and plays for Arsenal in that same game.

Cowthenbeef are third and everybody else would take them. I'm not everybody else. Cowthenbeef have Silva, with a clean sheet in each of his last two for AFC Bournemouth.

Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza do enough, with Gakpo the cleverest footballer in the tie.
